dialogues.speaker: Yaroslav
dialogues.text: Ah, I see you're not from around here, so let me be honest. What I really do is local business — for local people.

dialogues.speaker: Yaroslav
dialogues.text: On this vast land, most people spend their entire lives without ever crossing Snezhnaya's borders.

dialogues.speaker: Yaroslav
dialogues.text: But that doesn't mean they aren't curious about the outside world. It doesn't mean they don't long for something different.

dialogues.speaker: Yaroslav
dialogues.text: These little foreign curiosities — affordable, yet enough to weave a strange and distant dream...

dialogues.speaker: Yaroslav
dialogues.text: As they say, where there's demand, there's a market. Right?
